limitations: Original concept PNGs provide no physical ruler or calibrated cameras; absolute scale, hidden depth and faceting remain authored estimates.

Production animation, effects and exact held-weapon motion are checked separately by the runtime/root owner; this visual evidence covers actual static six-camera renders.
